description: This file contains utility functions for inviting members to teams, including email notifications, token creation, and membership management, within a larger project related to team and organization management.

methods.name: getTeamOrThrow
methods.description: Fetches a team by ID or throws an error if not found.

methods.name: createVerificationToken
methods.description: Creates a verification token for a user identifier and team ID.

methods.name: sendSignupToOrganizationEmail
methods.description: Sends an invitation email to sign up to an organization or team.

methods.name: sendEmails
methods.description: Sends multiple email promises and logs errors if any fail.

methods.name: sendExistingUserTeamInviteEmails
methods.description: Sends invitation emails to existing users for team membership.

methods.name: createMemberships
methods.description: Creates memberships for users in a team and optionally in a parent organization, tracking seat changes.
